rules.analysisBoundary: DiagnosticContext, source-contract reporting, target reporting and envelope conversion are observed through permanent focused tests before and after the scoped repair.
rules.deterministicIdentity: Cases are identified by their family and case ID; expected code, phase, source, severity and location semantics are fixed before observation.
rules.locationPolicy: A known zero-length span is a real insertion; unavailable source-origin metadata is represented as an unknown location.
rules.originPolicy: Query, Schema, DataSource, Runtime, GeneratedSource and Internal source domains remain distinct through envelope conversion.
rules.conflictPolicy: The table-couple fallback wording is recorded against the core null-versus-zero location contract and resolved explicitly in REC-126 evidence.
